prompts.warden-base: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original rear-view animation sprite sheet of the exact character in the SINGLE attached reference, which is the REAR design reference. Paint only the BACK of this character. Every single pose is oriented NORTHEAST, facing AWAY from viewer into the upper right. We see the rear of the head, back/spine, rear shoulders, back of arms, moss cloak or fur, and tail/root heels. No face, NO eyes, no visible mouth or facial features in ANY pose, even attacks and death. Ancient tall hollow tree guardian with branching antlers, warm lanterns, moss, root arms, drifting pale mist. Rear head is plain bark, back of branch antlers; no visible mask. Thin ink-and-gouache watercolor style, upper-left light, orthographic20degrees down. EXACT 6 columns x 2 rows, twelve equal square slots, 512pixel cells. TOP row slots1-3 slow idle breathing, slots4-6 stalking stride with alternate root feet. BOTTOM row slots1-2 hit flinches, slots3-4 stunned slump and flickering lanterns, slots5-6 arms raised roar with mist burst. Keep all subjects smaller than 75percent of slot height/width with generous transparent margins on ALL sides, constant figure scale, ground anchor near bottom. Do not let antler tips, head, root arms, tail or effects touch or cross any cell edge. Transparent background, no ground, shadows, backdrop, halos, text, labels, grid lines, borders or watermark. This is a REAR-ONLY sheet. Do not turn toward camera. Original design, no other game references.
